connector.name: Pulse Fetch by pulsemcp.com
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for fetching web resources with content extraction and anti-bot bypass.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package pulse-fetch. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.pulsemcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY

env.description: Bearer token for BrightData Web Unlocker service.

env.description: Path to markdown file containing scraping strategy configuration.

env.description: Optimization strategy for scraping: cost or speed.

env.name: MCP_RESOURCE_STORAGE
env.description: Storage backend for saved resources: memory or filesystem.

env.description: Directory for filesystem storage of resources.

env.name: SKIP_HEALTH_CHECKS
env.description: Skip API authentication health checks at startup.

env.name: LLM_PROVIDER
env.description: LLM provider for extraction: anthropic, openai, or openai-compatible.

env.description: API key for the chosen LLM provider.

env.name: LLM_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible LLM providers.

env.name: LLM_MODEL
env.description: Specific LLM model to use for extraction.
